name: assessments_team_capabilities
description: The caller's team as one set of capabilities, one role at a time: each capability's score is the mean of everyone's score on it against their own level, as a percentage (100 is the team meeting it on average), with how many were scored and how many are short. gaps lists capabilities where more than half are short. people is direct (direct reports, the default) or below (everyone below the caller); ratings is manager (the default), self or aligned. Only people whose score has unlocked count. compare is level (the default) or none: with level, each capability's group_median is everyone on the role at the team's levels, team included, from the level comparison's monthly snapshot of agreed ratings, weighted by how many of the team are at each level; comparison says when it was taken, or why there is no line (off, no_snapshot, or too_few with the short_levels under min_group_size). Nothing names anyone on the team.
